title: LSP Gets a Job
synopsis: Lumpy Space Princess is cut off by her parents and takes a job at Tree Trunks' pie stand, where she is, against all odds, good at it.
plot:
Lumpy Space Princess's parents freeze her allowance after she tries to charge a jacuzzi to the royal account. She is outraged and announces that she will get a job, like a commoner, and show them. Nobody will hire her except Tree Trunks, who needs someone to run the pie stand while she bakes.

LSP is a nightmare employee: late, dramatic, on her phone constantly. But customers keep coming back. It turns out that LSP's constant gossip is compelling, her complaints about the customers are hilarious, and she has an uncanny gift for guessing what kind of pie someone needs. Sales triple. Brad shows up and she refuses to serve him, which draws a crowd.

Her parents arrive to bring her home, having decided she has learned her lesson. LSP refuses. She has money now, her own money, and Tree Trunks gave her a name tag. Lumpy Space King buys a pie. LSP charges him double. He pays.
transcriptText:
Lumpy Space Queen: [from a portal] Your allowance is FROZEN, young lady!
Lumpy Space Princess: It was ONE jacuzzi!
Lumpy Space King: It was a jacuzzi for the entire Grass Lands!
Lumpy Space Princess: Ugh! FINE. I'll get a JOB. Like a PEASANT. And you'll be SORRY.
[Montage: doors slamming in LSP's face.]
Tree Trunks: Well, I could use a hand at the pie stand, sugar.
Lumpy Space Princess: Does it come with a name tag?
Tree Trunks: It can.
Lumpy Space Princess: I'm in.
[The pie stand. LSP lounges on the counter, phone in hand.]
Finn: Uh, hi LSP, can I get a—
Lumpy Space Princess: You want cherry. You look like you had a bad week. Cherry.
Finn: ...I did have a bad week.
Lumpy Space Princess: I KNOW. Four dollars.
Jake: I'll take—
Lumpy Space Princess: Blueberry. Don't argue with me, Jake.
Jake: [to Finn] She's right. I did want blueberry.
[Later. A line stretches down the hill.]
Mr. Pig: Tree Trunks, we've never had a line before.
Tree Trunks: I don't understand it either, Mr. Pig.
Lumpy Space Princess: [to a customer] And THEN Melissa said— oh my glob, what do you want, apple? You're an apple person. Six dollars.
Brad: Hey, LSP. Can I get—
Lumpy Space Princess: NO.
Brad: I didn't even—
Lumpy Space Princess: We're OUT. Forever. For YOU.
[The crowd cheers.]
Lumpy Space King: [arriving] Sweetheart, we've decided you've learned your lesson. Come home.
Lumpy Space Princess: I have a NAME TAG, Dad.
Lumpy Space King: ...Can I at least get a pie?
Lumpy Space Princess: Twelve dollars.
Lumpy Space King: It says six.
Lumpy Space Princess: Twelve.
Lumpy Space King: [paying] Twelve.
